en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4997 - Hammad narrated from Al-Halabi who reported from Abu Abdullah (as) that he said:

"An elderly man and an elderly woman are to be flogged one hundred lashes and then stoned.
A virgin man and a virgin woman are to be flogged one hundred lashes and exiled for a year. The exile is from one city to another.
Indeed, Commander of the Faithful (as) exiled two men from Kufa to Basra."
